name: icon-engine
title: Icon engine
description: createIcon() factory, IconProps (size, strokeWidth, aria-label, trigger hover|mount|loop|none, controlled active), choreography helpers and useIconTrigger (parent-button / data-yj-trigger hover, focus-visible, offscreen-paused loops, reduced motion).

name: youj-icon
title: YoujIcon
description: Adds 22 youj effects (pop, wiggle, spin, nudge, pulse, ring, bounce, flip, swing, float, heartbeat, shake, jelly, orbit, tilt, zoom-in/out and five draw modes) to any lucide-react icon, with intensity and RTL-aware direction, on the same triggers as the animated set.

name: icon-accessibility
title: Accessibility icon
description: Universal access: the figure raises both arms in a small cheer and lowers them again.

name: icon-activity
title: Activity icon
description: A heartbeat trace: a bright pulse runs along the line from left to right.

name: icon-alarm-clock
title: Alarm Clock icon
description: Silent ↔ ringing. The alarm goes off: the clock rattles on its feet and sound arcs open on both sides, and they stay while it rings. Silencing it closes the arcs and lets the clock settle. `active` = ringing.

name: icon-alert-triangle
title: Alert Triangle icon
description: The triangle rocks on its base; the exclamation jumps and the point lands a beat after.

name: icon-align-center-horizontal
title: Align Center Horizontal icon
description: Align vertical centers. The objects drift apart above and below the axis, the short one a beat behind, and snap back centered on it.

name: icon-align-center-vertical
title: Align Center Vertical icon
description: Align horizontal centers. The objects drift apart to opposite sides of the axis, the short one a beat behind, and snap back centered on it.

name: icon-align-center
title: Align Center icon
description: The short lines drift out to opposite margins and snap back to the center axis, one after the other.

name: icon-align-end-horizontal
title: Align End Horizontal icon
description: Align bottom. Both objects lift off the guide, the short one a beat behind, and snap back down against it.

name: icon-align-end-vertical
title: Align End Vertical icon
description: Align right. Both objects drift off the guide, the short one a beat behind, and snap back against it.

name: icon-align-justify
title: Align Justify icon
description: The lines fall back to ragged lengths all at once, then are set to full measure again one after another, top to bottom. The short last line stays as it is.

name: icon-align-left
title: Align Left icon
description: Left ↔ center. The ragged lines slide over to the center axis one after another; reversing sets them back against the left margin. The full-width line never moves. `active` = centered.

name: icon-align-right
title: Align Right icon
description: The short lines slip away from the right margin and snap back flush, one after the other. The full-width line never moves.

name: icon-align-start-horizontal
title: Align Start Horizontal icon
description: Align top. Both objects drop away from the guide, the short one a beat behind, and snap back up against it.

name: icon-align-start-vertical
title: Align Start Vertical icon
description: Align left. Both objects drift off the guide, the short one a beat behind, and snap back against it.

name: icon-anchor
title: Anchor icon
description: Harbour, port, anchored. The anchor swings from its ring like a weight on a line, each swing smaller than the last, and comes to rest hanging true.

name: icon-aperture
title: Aperture icon
description: Wide ↔ narrow. The iris closes down on its center, every blade sliding in together as the opening turns; opening up draws them back to the rim. `active` = narrow.

name: icon-app-window
title: App Window icon
description: The window lifts into focus and its title-bar controls light up one after another.

name: icon-archive-restore
title: Archive Restore icon
description: Archive ↔ restore. The lid lifts off the box as the arrow inside turns to point out of it; archiving again turns the arrow back in and the lid comes down on it. `active` = restore.

name: icon-archive
title: Archive icon
description: Filing away: the lid lifts, an item drops into the box, and the lid shuts on it with a thud.

name: icon-arrow-down-left
title: Arrow Down Left icon
description: The mirror of arrow-up-right: leaves along its own diagonal and slides back in from the opposite corner.

name: icon-arrow-down-right
title: Arrow Down Right icon
description: arrow-up-right turned a quarter clockwise: leaves along its own diagonal and slides back in from the opposite corner.

name: icon-arrow-down-to-line
title: Arrow Down To Line icon
description: Down to the end: the arrow winds up, drops to touch the line, and the line gives as it lands.

name: icon-arrow-down
title: Arrow Down icon
description: Drops out through the bottom and slides back in from the top, landing precisely.

name: icon-arrow-left-right
title: Arrow Left Right icon
description: Swap. The pair makes a half-turn about its center, each arrow taking the other's lane, and lands on its own silhouette. Rest is 180° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-arrow-left
title: Arrow Left icon
description: Back. The mirror of arrow-right: slips out to the left and slides back in from the right, landing precisely.

name: icon-arrow-right
title: Arrow Right icon
description: Nudges out to the right and re-enters from the left, landing precisely.

name: icon-arrow-up-down
title: Arrow Up Down icon
description: Sort. The up arrow rises out of frame and back in from below while the down arrow sinks out and back in from above, a beat behind.

name: icon-arrow-up-left
title: Arrow Up Left icon
description: arrow-up-right turned a quarter counter-clockwise: leaves along its own diagonal and slides back in from the opposite corner.

name: icon-arrow-up-right
title: Arrow Up Right icon
description: Leaves along its own diagonal and slides back in from the opposite corner.

name: icon-arrow-up-to-line
title: Arrow Up To Line icon
description: Back to the top: the arrow winds down, shoots up to touch the line, and the line gives as it lands.

name: icon-arrow-up
title: Arrow Up icon
description: Up ↔ down, for sort direction and show more / less. The arrow folds flat through its center and unfolds the other way; toggling mid-fold turns it straight back. `active` = down.

name: icon-asterisk
title: Asterisk icon
description: A fifth of a turn: the asterisk tightens, rotates exactly one ray and lands on its own shape. Rest is 72° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-at-sign
title: At Sign icon
description: The center pops, then the tail is written around it in one continuous stroke.

name: icon-audio-lines
title: Audio Lines icon
description: Silent ↔ speaking, for voice mode and live audio. The ticks stretch out into a waveform from the middle outward; going quiet draws them back in from the edges. `active` = speaking.

name: icon-award
title: Award icon
description: Awarded. The rosette swings on its pin like a pendulum and settles, the tails trailing a beat behind the medal.

name: icon-backspace
title: Backspace icon
description: The key is pressed toward its point and each stroke of the × pinches in to its centre and snaps back.

name: icon-badge-check
title: Badge Check icon
description: A seal of approval: the rosette is lifted, twisted and pressed down like a stamp, and the check is inked fresh as it lands.

name: icon-badge-percent
title: Badge Percent icon
description: On sale: the rosette turns an eighth and lands on its own outline while the percent holds still. Rest is 45° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-ban
title: Ban icon
description: Denied: the sign shakes its head, and the bar is struck through again.

name: icon-banknote
title: Banknote icon
description: Paid in cash: the note lifts as the seal in its middle flips over like a tossed coin, and it settles back down.

name: icon-bar-chart
title: Bar Chart icon
description: Bars grow up from the baseline, left to right.

name: icon-baseline
title: Baseline icon
description: Text colour: the letter hops and the colour bar under it is ruled again from left to right.

name: icon-battery-charging
title: Battery Charging icon
description: Battery ↔ charging. The three cells tilt and slide into one another until they fuse into a bolt that breaks through the casing top and bottom; unplugging splits the bolt back into cells. `active` = charging.

name: icon-battery-low
title: Battery Low icon
description: Low battery: the last cell blinks a warning.

name: icon-battery
title: Battery icon
description: Charging: the cells drain, then fill one by one.

name: icon-bell-dot
title: Bell Dot icon
description: Read ↔ unread. A badge pops onto the bell's shoulder with a settle and cuts its own gap out of the body, and the bell rings once beneath it; marking as read lets the badge shrink away and the gap closes behind it. `active` = unread.

name: icon-bell-off
title: Bell Off icon
description: Muted ↔ ringing. The slash is pulled out and the gap behind it closes, then the bell swings back to life with the clapper a beat late. Muting draws the slash back through a still bell. `active` = notifications on.

name: icon-bell-plus
title: Bell Plus icon
description: Add a notification: the bell swings from its crown as the plus beside it turns a quarter.

name: icon-bell
title: Bell icon
description: The body swings from its crown; the clapper follows a beat late and swings wider.

name: icon-bike
title: Bike icon
description: Pedalling off: the bike rolls forward and rocks back onto its wheels.

name: icon-binary
title: Binary icon
description: The bits flip: each digit turns over in place, one after another.

name: icon-bluetooth
title: Bluetooth icon
description: On ↔ connected. Pairing re-traces the rune in one continuous stroke, then the link dots spring out on both sides; disconnecting pulls them back in. `active` = connected.

name: icon-bold
title: Bold icon
description: Regular ↔ bold. The letter is struck twice and the two passes slide half a stroke apart, so every stem thickens the way a faux-bold is set; turning bold off slides them back together. `active` = bold.

name: icon-book-open
title: Book Open icon
description: Reading. A page lifts off the right, turns over the spine and settles onto the left.

name: icon-book
title: Book icon
description: The book is tipped off the shelf toward you and settles back upright.

name: icon-bookmark-plus
title: Bookmark Plus icon
description: Add to a collection → added. The ribbon tugs and the plus swings into a check with a small settle. `active` = added.

name: icon-bookmark
title: Bookmark icon
description: Save ↔ saved. The ribbon gives a small tug and fills from the top down, the fill landing with a settle; removing the bookmark drains it back up. `active` = saved.

name: icon-bot
title: Bot icon
description: Asleep ↔ awake, for an assistant or agent coming online. The eyes open by straightening from closed lids, the head gives a small hop and the antenna light comes on; putting it to sleep closes the eyes and the light goes out. `active` = awake.

name: icon-braces
title: Braces icon
description: An object fills in: the braces part to make room and three values are typed between them, held while hovered.

name: icon-brand-discord
title: Brand Discord icon
description: The Discord symbol, to link to a Discord server or sign in with Discord, per Discord's brand guidelines: Blurple, black or white, beside the Discord name. Static.

name: icon-brand-figma
title: Brand Figma icon
description: Figma's single-color icon, to link to Figma files or say a product works with Figma, per Figma's brand guidelines. Static.

name: icon-brand-github
title: Brand Github icon
description: The GitHub mark, to link to GitHub or sign in with it, per GitHub's logo guidelines: black, white or gray only. Static.

name: icon-brand-linkedin
title: Brand Linkedin icon
description: The LinkedIn [in] logo, to link to a LinkedIn profile or page, per LinkedIn's brand guidelines: blue, black or white only. Static.

name: icon-brand-x
title: Brand X icon
description: The X logo, to link to an X account or sign in with X, per X's brand guidelines: black or white only. Static.

name: icon-briefcase
title: Briefcase icon
description: Picked up. The case lifts by its handle, sways once as it hangs, and is set back down.

name: icon-brightness
title: Brightness icon
description: Dim ↔ bright. The core swells and each dot stretches out into a full ray, traveling clockwise from the top; dimming draws the rays back into dots the other way round. `active` = bright.

name: icon-brush
title: Brush icon
description: A brush stroke: the brush sweeps across from its handle and back.

name: icon-bug
title: Bug icon
description: Bug ↔ fixed. The legs curl in, the antennae droop, and a slash is struck through with a matching gap cut behind it. Reopening plays it back. `active` = fixed.

name: icon-building
title: Building icon
description: Office. The windows switch off and flicker back on, floor by floor from the ground up.

name: icon-bus
title: Bus icon
description: Pulling in: the bus bobs on its wheels and its lights flash.

name: icon-calculator
title: Calculator icon
description: Crunching numbers. Three keys press in turn down the diagonal, then the display clears and the result runs in from the right.

name: icon-calendar-check
title: Calendar Check icon
description: Open → booked. The day dots slide into line and a check is drawn through them; unbooking breaks the check back into days that return to the grid. `active` = booked.

name: icon-calendar-clock
title: Calendar Clock icon
description: Scheduling: the clock's minute hand sweeps a full hour while the hour hand steps on one mark. Rest is the full turn, so the sweep always runs forwards.

name: icon-calendar-minus
title: Calendar Minus icon
description: The bar pulls in from both ends and springs back out while the calendar tugs on its rings.

name: icon-calendar-plus
title: Calendar Plus icon
description: Add to calendar → added. Both bars of the plus swing clockwise into a check that lands with a small settle. `active` = added.

name: icon-calendar-range
title: Calendar Range icon
description: A date range: the span is drawn across the first week and carries on into the next.

name: icon-calendar-x
title: Calendar X icon
description: Cancelled: the calendar tugs on its rings while each stroke of the × pinches in to its centre and snaps back.

name: icon-calendar
title: Calendar icon
description: A day is torn off: the binding tugs and the sheet flips up over it and away, revealing the next one underneath. The flipping sheet sits exactly on the page below it, so it resets out of sight.

name: icon-camera-off
title: Camera Off icon
description: Camera off: the slash is drawn through the camera again with a matching gap cut behind it.

name: icon-camera
title: Camera icon
description: Shutter: the body dips, the aperture snaps shut and reopens, the flash blinks.

name: icon-caps-lock
title: Caps Lock icon
description: Caps Lock off ↔ on. Switching on fills the arrow from its stem up, like the key's light coming on; switching off drains it back into the stem. `active` = on.

name: icon-captions
title: Captions icon
description: Captions off ↔ on. A solid fill wipes across the frame from the left and the caption lines turn into cut-outs exactly where it passes, so the text is never drawn twice; switching off wipes it back. `active` = on.

name: icon-car
title: Car icon
description: Pulling away: the car rocks back on its springs as it moves off, then rolls forward and settles level.

name: icon-case-sensitive
title: Case Sensitive icon
description: Match case: the capital and the small letter hop in turn.

name: icon-cast
title: Cast icon
description: Idle ↔ casting. A pulse leaves the corner, the waves light up one after another, and the picture spreads across the screen from where they land. `active` = casting.

name: icon-chart-area
title: Chart Area icon
description: The filled series sinks toward the baseline and swells back up to its values.

name: icon-chart-candlestick
title: Chart Candlestick icon
description: The market moves: each candle rises or falls a little, out of step with its neighbours.

name: icon-chart-donut
title: Chart Donut icon
description: The ring turns a full revolution, carrying its slices round. Rest is 360° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-chart-scatter
title: Chart Scatter icon
description: The points are plotted one by one, each popping in where it lands.

name: icon-chart-spline
title: Chart Spline icon
description: Smooth ↔ linear, for a chart's line style. The curve pulls taut through its data points into straight segments; smoothing lets it relax back into a spline. `active` = linear.

name: icon-check-check
title: Check Check icon
description: Sent ↔ read. A second tick slides out from under the first and lands beside it with a settle, its short arm tucked behind the long one; marking as unread slides it back under. `active` = read.

name: icon-check-circle
title: Check Circle icon
description: The ring is drawn from twelve o'clock, then the check is written inside it.

name: icon-check
title: Check icon
description: Draws its stroke with a decisive ease-out, then settles with a tiny spring.

name: icon-chevron-down
title: Chevron Down icon
description: Disclosure chevron. `active` = expanded: the chevron turns over to point up.

name: icon-chevron-left
title: Chevron Left icon
description: The mirror of chevron-right, for trees read right to left and back panels. `active` = expanded: the chevron turns a quarter counter-clockwise to point down into the opened branch.

name: icon-chevron-right
title: Chevron Right icon
description: Tree disclosure. `active` = expanded: the chevron turns a quarter clockwise to point down into the opened branch.

name: icon-chevron-up
title: Chevron Up icon
description: Upward disclosure, the mirror of chevron-down. `active` = expanded: the chevron turns over to point down, for menus that open upward (a user menu at the foot of a sidebar) and show-less toggles.

name: icon-chevrons-down
title: Chevrons Down icon
description: Both chevrons push down: the rear one catches up with the lead, the pair holds a beat, then they part again.

name: icon-chevrons-left-right
title: Chevrons Left Right icon
description: Widen ↔ narrow, for resizable columns and panels that expand sideways. Both chevrons fold flat and turn inside out, so outward becomes inward; toggling mid-fold unfolds them again. `active` = expanded.

name: icon-chevrons-left
title: Chevrons Left icon
description: First page, back to the start. The mirror of chevrons-right: the lead chevron runs out to the edge and the rear one winds up and catches it, closing the gap, before both glide home together.

name: icon-chevrons-right
title: Chevrons Right icon
description: Last page, skip to the end. The lead chevron runs out to the edge and the rear one winds up and catches it, closing the gap, before both glide home together.

name: icon-chevrons-up-down
title: Chevrons Up Down icon
description: Expand ↔ collapse, for selects and expand-all toggles. Both chevrons fold flat and turn inside out, so up-down becomes down-up; toggling mid-fold unfolds them again. `active` = expanded.

name: icon-chevrons-up
title: Chevrons Up icon
description: Both chevrons push up: the rear one catches up with the lead, the pair holds a beat, then they part again.

name: icon-circle-alert
title: Circle Alert icon
description: Alert ↔ resolved. The ring braces, the exclamation bar tips over into the long arm of a check and its dot stretches into the short one; reopening stands the bar back up. `active` = resolved.

name: icon-circle-arrow-down
title: Circle Arrow Down icon
description: The arrow drops out through the bottom of the ring and comes round again from the top.

name: icon-circle-arrow-left
title: Circle Arrow Left icon
description: The arrow slips out through the left of the ring and comes round again from the right.

name: icon-circle-arrow-right
title: Circle Arrow Right icon
description: The arrow slips out through the right of the ring and comes round again from the left.

name: icon-circle-arrow-up
title: Circle Arrow Up icon
description: Send ↔ stop, for a prompt box while a reply streams in. The arrow opens its head and swings its shaft out into a square that fills solid; when generation ends the square folds back into the arrow. `active` = stop.

name: icon-circle-dashed
title: Circle Dashed icon
description: Pending ↔ done. The dashes chase round the ring like a loader and close their gaps one after another, then a check is written inside and lands with a settle. Undoing erases the check and breaks the ring back into dashes. `active` = done.

name: icon-circle-dollar
title: Circle Dollar icon
description: A coin flips over and lands face up again.

name: icon-circle-dot
title: Circle Dot icon
description: Selected. The center dot presses in and swells back to full, like a radio being chosen; the ring holds still.

name: icon-circle-help
title: Circle Help icon
description: A curious tilt: the question mark cocks its head on its base, and the dot hops a beat later.

name: icon-circle-minus
title: Circle Minus icon
description: Remove. The bar draws in to its center and springs back out to full width; the ring holds still.

name: icon-circle-pause
title: Circle Pause icon
description: The two bars dip in turn, like a held breath, and the button gives slightly under the press.

name: icon-circle-play
title: Circle Play icon
description: Play ↔ pause in a round button. The triangle folds flat into the left bar and the right bar slides in beside it. `active` = playing.

name: icon-circle-plus
title: Circle Plus icon
description: Add. The plus turns a quarter inside the ring, tucking in as it goes, and lands on its own silhouette; the ring holds still.

name: icon-circle-user
title: Circle User icon
description: An avatar that nods: the head dips and comes back up inside the ring, and the shoulders follow through a beat later.

name: icon-circle-x
title: Circle X icon
description: Error. The badge shakes its head while each stroke of the × pinches in to its center and snaps back, one after the other.

name: icon-circle
title: Circle icon
description: The ring opens a small gap at twelve o'clock, the gap runs once round the circle, and it closes where it started. Rest is a full turn, so leaving mid-lap finishes the lap forwards.

name: icon-clapperboard
title: Clapperboard icon
description: Action: the clapstick snaps shut on the board with a sharp close and swings back open on its hinge. Drawn shut; it rests open at −12°.

name: icon-clipboard-list
title: Clipboard List icon
description: Ticking through the list: each bullet pops in turn, top to bottom, and the clip snaps down.

name: icon-clipboard
title: Clipboard icon
description: Copy → copied. The two lines of text fold into a check and the clip snaps down on it. `active` = copied.

name: icon-clock
title: Clock icon
description: An hour passes: the minute hand sweeps once around while the hour hand steps forward one hour. The minute hand rests at a full turn, so leaving mid-sweep finishes the lap forwards.

name: icon-cloud-download
title: Cloud Download icon
description: Download → downloaded. The arrow drops out through the base, the cloud seals behind it, and a check is written inside. `active` = downloaded.

name: icon-cloud-fog
title: Cloud Fog icon
description: Fog rolls through: the banks of mist drift one way and the other under the cloud.

name: icon-cloud-lightning
title: Cloud Lightning icon
description: A strike: the cloud rumbles, the bolt is thrown down in an instant and flickers twice before it holds.

name: icon-cloud-moon
title: Cloud Moon icon
description: A cloudy night: the cloud drifts across and the moon behind it rocks gently.

name: icon-cloud-off
title: Cloud Off icon
description: Offline ↔ online. The slash is pulled out and the gap behind it closes, then the cloud takes a breath and lifts back into place; losing the connection draws the slash back through a still cloud. `active` = online.

name: icon-cloud-rain
title: Cloud Rain icon
description: Rain: each drop falls out of view and the next one slides down out of the cloud, in a loose, uneven cadence.

name: icon-cloud-snow
title: Cloud Snow icon
description: Snowing: the flakes drift down out of the cloud, swaying as they fall, and new ones form beneath it.

name: icon-cloud-sun
title: Cloud Sun icon
description: Sun ↔ rain. The rays pull in, the cloud swells and drifts over the sun until it's gone, then rain starts to fall from it; clearing up plays it back, drops first. `active` = rain.

name: icon-cloud-upload
title: Cloud Upload icon
description: Upload → uploaded. The arrow launches up through the cloud, the gap in its base seals, and a check is written inside. `active` = uploaded.

name: icon-cloud
title: Cloud icon
description: Cloud ↔ synced. An upload chevron rises into the cloud and folds over into a check; unsyncing unfolds it and lets it sink away. `active` = synced.

name: icon-code-xml
title: Code Xml icon
description: The brackets part and a slash is written between them, so < > becomes </> while hovered.

name: icon-code
title: Code icon
description: Code ↔ JSON. The angle brackets draw inward and soften into curly braces, the right one a beat behind the left; reverting straightens them out again. `active` = braces.

name: icon-coffee
title: Coffee icon
description: A break: steam curls up off the cup and fades, one wisp after another, and fresh wisps form again above it.

name: icon-coins
title: Coins icon
description: A coin toss: the front coin spins a full turn on its axis, uncovering the coin behind it each time it turns edge-on.

name: icon-columns
title: Columns icon
description: Two ↔ three columns. The center divider splits in two and the halves slide out to the thirds; merging draws them back into one. `active` = three columns.

name: icon-command
title: Command icon
description: A keypress: the key dips under the finger and the ⌘ is retraced in one continuous stroke through all four loops.

name: icon-compass
title: Compass icon
description: The needle swings, overshoots north and finds it again, like a real compass damping out.

name: icon-contact
title: Contact icon
description: Looking someone up: the person in the address book nods and the tabs give a little.

name: icon-container
title: Container icon
description: Shipped: the container is lifted a touch and its ribs ripple from one end to the other.

name: icon-contrast
title: Contrast icon
description: The dark half turns all the way over to the other side and back round. Rest is 360° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-cookie
title: Cookie icon
description: Cookie consent: the cookie wobbles on the spot and its chips pop in turn, as if asking to be taken.

name: icon-copy-plus
title: Copy Plus icon
description: Duplicate. The two sheets slide apart and hold there, and the plus on the new one pops in; letting go stacks them again.

name: icon-copy
title: Copy icon
description: Copy → copied. The back sheet tucks in behind the front one, then a check is written on the page. Reverting erases the check first.

name: icon-corner-down-left
title: Corner Down Left icon
description: Enter. A carriage return: the stroke runs down and sweeps back to the start of the line, and the head is pushed out at its end.

name: icon-corner-down-right
title: Corner Down Right icon
description: The path is drawn down and round the corner, and the head arrives at its end as the line does.

name: icon-corner-up-left
title: Corner Up Left icon
description: The path is drawn up and round to the left, and the head arrives at its end as the line does.

name: icon-corner-up-right
title: Corner Up Right icon
description: The path is drawn up and round to the right, and the head arrives at its end as the line does.

name: icon-cpu
title: CPU icon
description: A clock cycle: a current runs round the pins clockwise and the core ticks over a quarter turn. Rest is 90° so leaving mid-tick finishes forwards.

name: icon-credit-card
title: Credit Card icon
description: Card ↔ paid. The card taps like a contactless payment, the number is wiped, and the magnetic stripe folds down into a check. Reverting unfolds it. `active` = paid.

name: icon-crop
title: Crop icon
description: Tightening the crop: both corner brackets slide in along the diagonal together, then ease back out to the frame.

name: icon-crosshair
title: Crosshair icon
description: Locate ↔ locked. The ticks close in and the ring tightens as it acquires, then everything springs back open as the center locks on with a settle. `active` = locked.

name: icon-crown
title: Crown icon
description: Crowned: the crown is lifted, tips jauntily to one side and is set back down level on its band.

name: icon-database
title: Database icon
description: Records sync: each ring of the cylinder lifts in turn, bottom to top.

name: icon-disc
title: Disc icon
description: Spinning up: the disc turns half a revolution under its glints, fast off the mark and coasting to a stop.

name: icon-divide
title: Divide icon
description: Divided: the dots are pushed away from the bar and spring back.

name: icon-dollar-sign
title: Dollar Sign icon
description: Money. The S rewinds into its top terminal and is written again while the bar holds.

name: icon-door
title: Door icon
description: Closed ↔ open, for rooms, exits and access. The door swings in on its hinge and its handle travels with the free edge, leaving the doorway open; closing swings it back flush with the frame. `active` = open.

name: icon-dot
title: Dot icon
description: A blip: a ring ripples out from the dot to the edge of the keyline circle and fades as it goes, while the dot swells once and settles. With `trigger="loop"` it's a live indicator.

name: icon-download
title: Download icon
description: The arrow drops into the tray, the tray takes the weight, a fresh arrow slides in from above.

name: icon-droplet
title: Droplet icon
description: Wobbling like water: the drop stretches up, squashes down on its base and settles, with a glint inside that rides along.

name: icon-droplets
title: Droplets icon
description: Humid: the two drops fall in turn, a short way each, and settle back.

name: icon-eject
title: Eject icon
description: Ejected: the triangle pops up off the bar and drops back.

name: icon-ellipsis-vertical
title: Ellipsis Vertical icon
description: More, stood upright, for row and card menus. A single wave runs down the column: each dot steps out and back in turn, top to bottom. Unlike more-vertical it keeps its shape.

name: icon-ellipsis
title: Ellipsis icon
description: More, overflow, truncated. A single wave runs along the row: each dot lifts and lands in turn, left to right. Unlike more-horizontal it keeps its shape: use it where nothing opens, such as a gap in pagination.

name: icon-equal
title: Equal icon
description: The two bars part a little and close back to equal.

name: icon-eraser
title: Eraser icon
description: Rubbing out: the eraser works back and forth along the line on its tip, each stroke a little shorter.

name: icon-euro
title: Euro icon
description: Money in euros: the curve is written again round the bars.

name: icon-external-link
title: External Link icon
description: Open in a new tab. The arrow leaves through the box's open corner and a fresh one slides out of the box after it.

name: icon-eye-closed
title: Eye Closed icon
description: Open ↔ closed, for password fields and hide-content toggles. The upper lid sweeps down in a blink and meets the lower one as the pupil shrinks away, then the lashes grow out of the closed lid; opening folds the lashes in first. `active` = closed.

name: icon-eye-off
title: Eye Off icon
description: Hidden. The eye blinks behind the slash, which holds.

name: icon-eye
title: Eye icon
description: Eye ↔ eye-off. The eye blinks shut, and as it reopens a slash is drawn through it with a matching gap cut behind. `active` = hidden.

name: icon-factory
title: Factory icon
description: At work: the windows along the floor light up in turn.

name: icon-fast-forward
title: Fast Forward icon
description: Seeking ahead: both triangles surge forward twice, the rear one chasing the front a beat behind.

name: icon-file-archive
title: File Archive icon
description: The zip pull slides down the teeth and back up, closing the archive again.

name: icon-file-audio
title: File Audio icon
description: The note on the page bobs to a beat, tipping on its head and back.

name: icon-file-check
title: File Check icon
description: The check is drawn onto the page again, stroke by stroke, like signing it off.

name: icon-file-code
title: File Code icon
description: A source file. The angle brackets spread apart and snap back, the right one a beat behind.

name: icon-file-diff
title: File Diff icon
description: Comparing changes: the plus turns a quarter and the minus pulses under it, one after the other.

name: icon-file-image
title: File Image icon
description: An image file. The sun sinks behind the ridge and rises again.

name: icon-file-json
title: File JSON icon
description: A JSON file. The braces part, a value blinks in between them, and they close over it.

name: icon-file-lock
title: File Lock icon
description: The shackle on the page lifts to check the lock and drops back shut.

name: icon-file-minus
title: File Minus icon
description: The bar pulls in from both ends and springs back out while the page settles under it.

name: icon-file-pen
title: File Pen icon
description: Editing a document: the pen scribbles and the line it writes is drawn again.

name: icon-file-plus
title: File Plus icon
description: Add → added. Both bars of the plus swing clockwise into a check that lands with a small settle. `active` = added.

name: icon-file-search
title: File Search icon
description: The lens looks over the page, down one side and back, and returns to the middle.

name: icon-file-spreadsheet
title: File Spreadsheet icon
description: The grid on the page is ruled again, the row line first and then the column.

name: icon-file-terminal
title: File Terminal icon
description: A shell script. The prompt steps forward and the cursor blinks twice, waiting for input.

name: icon-file-text
title: File Text icon
description: The text is cleared and retyped line by line, heading first.

name: icon-file-video
title: File Video icon
description: The play mark on the page presses in and springs forward, like starting the clip.

name: icon-file-x
title: File X icon
description: Rejected: the page shakes its head while each stroke of the × pinches in to its centre and snaps back.

name: icon-file
title: File icon
description: The dog-ear flicks up flat and falls back into its fold.

name: icon-files
title: Files icon
description: The top page slides aside a little, showing the one behind, and settles back on the stack.

name: icon-film
title: Film icon
description: The strip advances one frame through the gate: sprocket holes and frame line pull down together in a single claw stroke. Rest is the end of the advance, so leaving mid-pull finishes it.

name: icon-filter
title: Filter icon
description: Each bar narrows in turn, top to bottom, like results being sifted.

name: icon-fingerprint
title: Fingerprint icon
description: A scan line sweeps down the pad and each ridge is re-traced as it passes.

name: icon-flag
title: Flag icon
description: Unflagged ↔ flagged. A ripple runs through the cloth from the pole to the tip while it fills from the pole outward; unflagging runs the ripple again as the fill drains back to the pole. `active` = flagged.

name: icon-flame
title: Flame icon
description: Burning bright: the flame licks left and right on its wick, its core flaring as it goes, and steadies.

name: icon-flask
title: Flask icon
description: An experiment: the liquid sloshes and two bubbles rise through it and pop at the surface, then form again at the bottom out of sight.

name: icon-flip-horizontal
title: Flip Horizontal icon
description: Original ↔ flipped. The solid shape folds edge-on into the mirror axis and opens out on the other side, while its outline ghost flips the other way to take its old place. `active` = flipped.

name: icon-flip-vertical
title: Flip Vertical icon
description: Original ↔ flipped. The solid shape folds edge-on into the mirror axis and opens out on the other side, while its outline ghost flips the other way to take its old place. `active` = flipped.

name: icon-folder-check
title: Folder Check icon
description: The check is drawn onto the folder again, stroke by stroke, like marking it done.

name: icon-folder-input
title: Folder Input icon
description: Move to folder. The arrow slides on into the folder and fades, and a fresh one comes in through the opening.

name: icon-folder-lock
title: Folder Lock icon
description: The shackle on the folder lifts to check the lock and drops back shut.

name: icon-folder-minus
title: Folder Minus icon
description: The bar pulls in from both ends and springs back out while the folder settles under it.

name: icon-folder-open
title: Folder Open icon
description: Open. The front panel tips a little further on its hinge, as if leafing through, and settles back.

name: icon-folder-plus
title: Folder Plus icon
description: New folder → created. The folder takes the new item with a small dip as its plus swings into a check. `active` = added.

name: icon-folder-search
title: Folder Search icon
description: The lens looks through the folder, to one side and the other, and returns to the middle.

name: icon-folder-tree
title: Folder Tree icon
description: The branches are drawn out from the root and each child folder pops in at the end of its branch.

name: icon-folder
title: Folder icon
description: Closed ↔ open. The front panel tips forward on its hinge and the back of the folder shows above it. `active` = open.

name: icon-folders
title: Folders icon
description: The front folder lifts off the one behind it and settles back down.

name: icon-forward
title: Forward icon
description: Passed on: the arrow draws back, throws itself forward along its curve and lands in shape.

name: icon-frame
title: Frame icon
description: Resizing: the right and bottom edges are dragged out from the corner, then let go back to size.

name: icon-frown
title: Frown icon
description: Disappointed: the face shakes its head slowly and the frown deepens, then it all relaxes.

name: icon-fuel
title: Fuel icon
description: Filling up: the nozzle lifts off its hook and the display flickers as the litres count.

name: icon-function
title: Function icon
description: The ƒ is written out again, the stem first and then the crossbar.

name: icon-funnel
title: Funnel icon
description: All ↔ filtered. The funnel dips as it catches the pour and fills from the rim down into the stem; clearing the filter drains it back up and out. `active` = filtered.

name: icon-gamepad
title: Gamepad icon
description: In play: the pad tilts as the buttons are pressed, one after the other.

name: icon-gauge
title: Gauge icon
description: Low ↔ high. The needle sweeps a quarter turn across the dial on its pivot and lands on its mark without overshoot. `active` = high.

name: icon-gem
title: Gem icon
description: Premium: the stone turns in the light, its facets sliding across the table and girdle and back.

name: icon-gift
title: Gift icon
description: Closed ↔ open. The lid pops off with its bow and tips back, and the pop is allowed its one bounce. Closing sets the lid straight back down. `active` = open.

name: icon-git-branch
title: Git Branch icon
description: History is replayed: the trunk grows, the branch forks off it, and the new commit lands.

name: icon-git-commit
title: Git Commit icon
description: History advances: the line scrolls one commit to the left, the current node sliding off and fading as the next arrives from the right and lands in its place.

name: icon-git-compare
title: Git Compare icon
description: Comparing: each arrow pushes toward the other branch and draws back, crossing the same beat, while both heads nod in.

name: icon-git-fork
title: Git Fork icon
description: Forking: the trunk grows up from the source, splits both ways at the junction, and each copy pops as its branch arrives.

name: icon-git-merge
title: Git Merge icon
description: The feature branch is traced back into main, and main's head gives a small pop as the merge commit lands.

name: icon-git-pull-request-closed
title: Git Pull Request Closed icon
description: Closed without merging: each stroke of the × over the branch pinches in and snaps back.

name: icon-git-pull-request-draft
title: Git Pull Request Draft icon
description: Still a draft: the dotted lane fills in dot by dot, as if the branch were being written.

name: icon-git-pull-request
title: Git Pull Request icon
description: Open ↔ merged. The arrowhead folds away, the head branch swings over and joins the base lane, and the base lane runs on through the commit it absorbs. `active` = merged.

name: icon-globe
title: Globe icon
description: The globe turns on its axis: the meridians roll one step east and fade as they reach the rim. Rest is the end of the turn, so leaving mid-turn finishes it forwards.

name: icon-grid
title: Grid icon
description: Grid hidden ↔ shown, for canvases and layout guides. Each crossing dot stretches out both ways to the frame, one after another round the grid; hiding draws the lines back into their dots. `active` = shown.

name: icon-grip-horizontal
title: Grip Horizontal icon
description: Horizontal drag handle, idle ↔ grabbed. When gripped, each column's dots reach for each other and fuse into an upright bar while the columns draw in tight; letting go springs them back into dots. `active` = grabbed.

name: icon-grip
title: Grip icon
description: Drag handle, idle ↔ grabbed. When gripped, each row's dots reach for each other and fuse into a bar while the rows draw in tight; letting go springs them back into dots. `active` = grabbed, e.g. while dragging.

name: icon-hammer
title: Hammer icon
description: A blow: the hammer draws back on its grip and strikes, dipping in scale through the swing so the head never leaves the grid, then settles.

name: icon-hand
title: Hand icon
description: A wave from the wrist: the hand swings out and back, each swing smaller, and comes to rest upright.

name: icon-hard-drive
title: Hard Drive icon
description: Disk activity: the two lights on the drive flicker out of step, as if reading and writing.

name: icon-hash
title: Hash icon
description: A channel: the bars of the hash shuffle, the slants leaning further while the crossbars slide apart, then everything clicks back into its grid.

name: icon-heading
title: Heading icon
description: Promoted to a heading: the letter grows taller from its baseline, crossbar riding up with it, and settles back.

name: icon-headphones
title: Headphones icon
description: Bass drops: the ear cups thump outward twice on the beat and the headband flexes with them.

name: icon-headset
title: Headset icon
description: Support is listening: the band settles on and the mic boom swings round to the mouth.

name: icon-heart
title: Heart icon
description: Like. The heart squeezes, pops past full size and settles (the one place a bounce is earned), fills, and throws a ring of particles. `active` = liked.

name: icon-hexagon
title: Hexagon icon
description: A sixth of a turn: the hexagon tightens, rotates one side on and lands on its own outline. Rest is 60° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-highlighter
title: Highlighter icon
description: Highlighting a phrase: the marker lifts back along the line as the old highlight is taken up, then sweeps forward and lays it down again.

name: icon-history
title: History icon
description: Time rewinds: the arrow winds back around the dial while the minute hand spins a full turn counter-clockwise and the hour hand steps back an hour.

name: icon-home
title: Home icon
description: The roof lifts and sets back down; the door is drawn open underneath it.

name: icon-hourglass
title: Hourglass icon
description: Loops by default. The sand level drains down the funnel while the pile below rises, then the glass turns over. The full pile, turned over, is exactly the full top bulb, so the loop has no seam. Static fallback: a full top bulb.

name: icon-id-card
title: ID Card icon
description: The card is read: its details dim, a scan line sweeps across, and each detail is restored as the line passes over it.

name: icon-image-plus
title: Image Plus icon
description: Add an image → added. The sun dips behind the ridge and the plus beside the frame swings into a check. `active` = added.

name: icon-image
title: Image icon
description: The sun sets behind the ridge and rises again as the ridge line redraws.

name: icon-images
title: Images icon
description: Flicking through: the front photo slides aside a little, showing the one behind, and settles back.

name: icon-inbox
title: Inbox icon
description: A message drops in and the tray dips to catch it.

name: icon-indent
title: Indent icon
description: Outdent ↔ indent. The chevron folds flat and turns to point into the text as the two middle lines step in after it; outdenting turns it back and pulls the lines out. `active` = indent.

name: icon-infinity
title: Infinity icon
description: The loop is traced again from its crossing, round both sides and back.

name: icon-info
title: Info icon
description: The stem is drawn upward, then the dot drops onto it.

name: icon-italic
title: Italic icon
description: The letter leans further into its slant, the way type is set in italic, and comes back to rest.

name: icon-kanban
title: Kanban icon
description: A card moves on: the first column gives one up and the next column grows to take it, held while hovered.

name: icon-key
title: Key icon
description: Into the lock: the key pushes in along its blade and turns, its teeth flipping over to the far side; releasing turns it back and draws it out.

name: icon-keyboard
title: Keyboard icon
description: Typing: keys dip in a quick, uneven rhythm like a word being typed, then the space bar lands.

name: icon-landmark
title: Landmark icon
description: The columns rise into place one by one under the roof, which settles on top.

name: icon-languages
title: Languages icon
description: Translate. The two scripts trade places, circling each other clockwise and staying upright as they go; they hold there while hovered and circle back when released.

name: icon-laptop
title: Laptop icon
description: The lid swings shut onto its hinge, the base takes the weight, and the lid lifts open again.

name: icon-lasso
title: Lasso icon
description: Freeform select: the dashed loop marches round like a live selection.

name: icon-layers
title: Layers icon
description: The stack fans open so each layer reads on its own, and closes again on release.

name: icon-layout-dashboard
title: Layout Dashboard icon
description: Dashboard. The layout reflows once: the chart row sinks and the stat cards grow into the space it leaves, then the cards give it back and the chart row rises into place. The gutters never close.

name: icon-layout-grid
title: Layout Grid icon
description: Tiles dip one after another, clockwise, like a layout reflowing.

name: icon-layout-list
title: Layout List icon
description: List ↔ grid, for view switchers. Row by row, each pair of lines bows apart and rounds off into a tile beside its thumbnail; back to the list, the tiles flatten into lines again, last row first. `active` = grid.

name: icon-leaf
title: Leaf icon
description: A breeze: the leaf sways on its stalk, back and forth and settling, the vein traveling with it.

name: icon-library
title: Library icon
description: The leaning book straightens up against the others and tips back to rest.

name: icon-life-buoy
title: Life Buoy icon
description: Help is on its way. The buoy turns one stripe on (90°) with a heavy ease-out, like a ratchet. Rest is 90°, so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-lightbulb
title: Lightbulb icon
description: Off ↔ on. The filament catches with a flicker, then light radiates out, top first and then down both sides; switching off pulls the rays back in the reverse order. `active` = on.

name: icon-line-chart
title: Line Chart icon
description: The series is plotted left to right and the latest point lands with a small settle.

name: icon-link
title: Link icon
description: The two halves pull apart, the bar stretches thin, then they snap back together.

name: icon-list-checks
title: List Checks icon
description: Tasks get done: each tick is written in turn, top to bottom, and lands with a small settle.

name: icon-list-collapse
title: List Collapse icon
description: Expanded ↔ collapsed, for outlines, trees and collapse-all. The children fold up into their parent row, last one first, and the chevron turns to point right; expanding drops them back out under it. `active` = collapsed.

name: icon-list-music
title: List Music icon
description: The playlist plays on: the note hops twice to a beat beside the tracks.

name: icon-list-ordered
title: List Ordered icon
description: Counting off: the numerals are written again in order, 1 then 2, as if the list were being numbered.

name: icon-list-plus
title: List Plus icon
description: A new row is on its way: the plus turns a quarter with a small press and the short lines reach out to make room.

name: icon-list
title: List icon
description: Bulleted ↔ checklist. Row by row, each bullet unfolds into a tick and its line steps aside to make room; reversing folds the ticks back into dots, last row first. `active` = checklist.

name: icon-loader-dots
title: Loader Dots icon
description: Three dots rise and brighten in a traveling wave. Loops by default; static fallback is three dots.

name: icon-loader-ring
title: Loader Ring icon
description: Indeterminate spinner: a constant-rate turn with an arc that breathes on a different period, so the motion never visibly repeats. Loops by default. Static fallback: a quarter arc on a faint track.

name: icon-lock-open
title: Lock Open icon
description: Unlocked. The shackle dips toward the body as if about to lock, the keyhole flicks, and it swings back open.

name: icon-lock
title: Lock icon
description: Lock ↔ unlock. The shackle rises clear of the body, then swings open on its left leg. `active` = unlocked.

name: icon-log-in
title: Log In icon
description: Log in ↔ log out. The arrow walks through the doorway while the door swings round behind it, edge-on half-way, so the same frame now shows the way out. Toggling mid-swing sends both back. `active` = log out (signed in).

name: icon-log-out
title: Log Out icon
description: Leave. The arrow walks out to the right and a new one steps out of the doorway after it, head first.

name: icon-logs
title: Logs icon
description: Tailing a log: a new line comes in at the bottom and every line above it scrolls up one, the oldest leaving at the top.

name: icon-magnet
title: Magnet icon
description: Snapping: the magnet jerks toward something and settles, with a little wobble.

name: icon-mail-check
title: Mail Check icon
description: Delivered: the flap closes down once more and the check beside it is signed off.

name: icon-mail-open
title: Mail Open icon
description: Read ↔ unread. The flap folds down over the letter and the envelope lifts as it seals. `active` = unread.

name: icon-mail-plus
title: Mail Plus icon
description: New message → added. The plus beside the envelope swings into a check while the envelope lifts. `active` = added.

name: icon-mail
title: Mail icon
description: The flap flattens open and a letter's lines rise out of the envelope.

name: icon-mailbox
title: Mailbox icon
description: You have post: the flag drops and springs back up.

name: icon-map-pin-off
title: Map Pin Off icon
description: Location off: the slash is drawn through the pin again with a matching gap cut behind it.

name: icon-map-pin-plus
title: Map Pin Plus icon
description: Add a place → added. The pin bobs and the plus inside it swings into a check. `active` = added.

name: icon-map-pin
title: Map Pin icon
description: Pin ↔ dropped. The pin hops, drops onto its spot and lands with a squash and a small settle; a ground ring spreads out beneath it and its center fills. Lifting it clears the ring. `active` = dropped.

name: icon-map
title: Map icon
description: Unfolding: both side panels fold in toward the middle one, then open back out flat, the right a beat behind the left.

name: icon-maximize
title: Maximize icon
description: Maximize ↔ minimize. Every corner folds through its own diagonal, from the window's edge to pointing inward, like a window giving way; toggling mid-fold swings them back. `active` = minimize.

name: icon-megaphone
title: Megaphone icon
description: An announcement: the horn kicks back as it blasts, and the sound goes out from its mouth one wave after the other.

name: icon-meh
title: Meh icon
description: Neither here nor there: the flat mouth slides to one side and back, and the eyes blink.

name: icon-memory-stick
title: Memory Stick icon
description: Under load: the chips on the module light up in turn along the board.

name: icon-menu
title: Menu icon
description: Menu ↔ close. The outer bars converge on the center, then cross; the middle bar collapses into the pivot. Closing plays the exact reverse.

name: icon-message-dots
title: Message Dots icon
description: Message ↔ typing. The lines of text draw together into the three dots of a typing indicator; when the reply lands they spread back out into text. `active` = typing.

name: icon-message-heart
title: Message Heart icon
description: A kind word: the heart in the bubble beats twice.

name: icon-message-plus
title: Message Plus icon
description: Start a conversation: the plus turns a quarter inside the bubble with a small press, and the bubble swells.

name: icon-message-question
title: Message Question icon
description: A puzzled question: the question mark tilts one way and the other while its dot bobs.

name: icon-message-sparkle
title: Message Sparkle icon
description: Ask AI. The bubble lifts as if it were about to speak and the star inside turns a quarter, breathing in on the way.

name: icon-message
title: Message icon
description: Someone is typing: the three dots ripple through the bubble twice.

name: icon-messages
title: Messages icon
description: A conversation: the front bubble speaks up, then the reply behind it answers. The reply is a whole bubble, masked by a gap around the front one, so they can move independently without ever touching.

name: icon-mic
title: Mic icon
description: Mic ↔ muted. A slash is drawn through the mic and a matching gap is cut behind it with a mask, so the strokes never collide.

name: icon-minimize
title: Minimize icon
description: Collapse. The four corners pinch in toward the center, as if the window were already shrinking, and let go.

name: icon-minus
title: Minus icon
description: Minus ↔ plus, for steppers, accordions and zoom. An upright grows out of the bar's center in both directions at once; collapsing folds it back into the bar. `active` = plus.

name: icon-monitor
title: Monitor icon
description: Power-on: current runs out along the foot, up the neck, and around both sides of the screen until they meet at the top.

name: icon-moon
title: Moon icon
description: Night falls: the crescent rocks gently and the star beside it winks on with a turn.

name: icon-more-horizontal
title: More Horizontal icon
description: More ↔ close, for overflow menus. The outer dots stretch into the arms of an × as they swing to the center, and the middle dot gives way to the crossing; closing draws them back into dots. `active` = open (close).

name: icon-more-vertical
title: More Vertical icon
description: More ↔ close, for row and card menus. The outer dots stretch into the arms of an × as they swing to the center, and the middle dot gives way to the crossing; closing draws them back into dots. `active` = open (close).

name: icon-mountain
title: Mountain icon
description: Landscape, terrain, the outdoors. A sun rises from behind the lower peak and holds there while hovered; leaving sets it behind the ridge again.

name: icon-mouse-pointer
title: Mouse Pointer icon
description: A click: the pointer presses in toward its tip and three rays flash out from the point of contact.

name: icon-mouse
title: Mouse icon
description: Scrolling: the wheel rolls down two notches, each mark sliding out below as the next rolls in from above.

name: icon-move
title: Move icon
description: Four ways at once: the arms push out from the center, parting in the middle, and draw back together.

name: icon-music
title: Music icon
description: The note hops twice to a beat, rocking on its heel.

name: icon-navigation
title: Navigation icon
description: Navigating ↔ arrived. The heading arrow swings round to point down and swells into a location pin, then its center is drawn in; setting off again sharpens the pin back into the arrow. `active` = arrived.

name: icon-network
title: Network icon
description: Connecting: the links between the three nodes are drawn in turn round the mesh.

name: icon-newspaper
title: Newspaper icon
description: The headline box flashes and the columns under it are set again, line by line.

name: icon-nfc
title: Nfc icon
description: Tap to pay: the waves ripple outward from the point of contact, smallest first.

name: icon-notebook
title: Notebook icon
description: The cover lifts on its rings and falls shut again, the rings giving a little as it does.

name: icon-octagon-alert
title: Octagon Alert icon
description: Stop. The sign braces with a short press, and the exclamation jumps with its point landing a beat after.

name: icon-package
title: Package icon
description: In transit ↔ delivered. The box is set down with a soft thud and its tape folds into a check on the lid. `active` = delivered.

name: icon-paint-bucket
title: Paint Bucket icon
description: Fill: the bucket tips over its rim and a drop of paint falls from it as it rights itself.

name: icon-paint-roller
title: Paint Roller icon
description: Rolling paint on: the roller sweeps up and down the wall on its handle.

name: icon-palette
title: Palette icon
description: Picking colors: the palette tips in the hand and each well of paint pops in turn, round the rim.

name: icon-panel-bottom
title: Panel Bottom icon
description: Bottom panel open ↔ closed, for terminals, consoles and drawers. The panel's divider lets go of the frame and folds into a chevron pointing up; opening unfolds it back into the divider. `active` = closed.

name: icon-panel-right
title: Panel Right icon
description: Inspector open ↔ closed. The right panel's divider pulls free of the frame and folds into a chevron pointing where the panel will slide back from; opening unfolds it again. `active` = closed.

name: icon-paperclip
title: Paperclip icon
description: Attach. The outer loop unwinds back along the wire and is bent round again, as if clipping onto a sheet.

name: icon-party-popper
title: Party Popper icon
description: Celebrate. The popper kicks back in the hand and throws its confetti out of the mouth, each piece flying to where it rests while the streamer unfurls after them.

name: icon-pen-tool
title: Pen Tool icon
description: Drawing a path: the nib tilts one way and the other on its point, like setting an anchor.

name: icon-pencil
title: Pencil icon
description: The pencil scribbles a stroke underneath itself.

name: icon-percent
title: Percent icon
description: A price cut: the slash slices through corner to corner and knocks the two rings apart, then they drift back together.

name: icon-phone-call
title: Phone Call icon
description: Call ↔ hang up. The signal arcs retract into the earpiece, outermost first, and the handset turns 135° into the hang-up pose. Reconnecting turns it back and the arcs radiate out again. `active` = in a call (shows hang up).

name: icon-phone-incoming
title: Phone Incoming icon
description: An incoming call: the arrow arrives at the handset from outside and the handset gives a short ring.

name: icon-phone-missed
title: Phone Missed icon
description: A missed call: the handset rings once more, too late, and each stroke of the × pinches in beside it.

name: icon-phone-off
title: Phone Off icon
description: The line is cut again: the slash is redrawn through the handset with a matching gap cut behind it.

name: icon-phone-outgoing
title: Phone Outgoing icon
description: An outgoing call: the arrow leaves the handset and a fresh one follows it out.

name: icon-phone
title: Phone icon
description: Incoming call: the handset buzzes and signal arcs pulse out of the earpiece.

name: icon-picture-in-picture
title: Picture In Picture icon
description: Inline ↔ picture in picture. The video shrinks into the corner of the screen and fills in as a floating window; bringing it back grows it out of the corner to fill the screen again. `active` = floating.

name: icon-pie-chart
title: Pie Chart icon
description: The body is traced around, then the slice pulls out along its diagonal and settles there.

name: icon-piggy-bank
title: Piggy Bank icon
description: Saving: a coin drops through the slot and the next one appears above it.

name: icon-pilcrow
title: Pilcrow icon
description: A new paragraph: the bowl of the mark is filled in again around its stems.

name: icon-pin-off
title: Pin Off icon
description: Unpin. The slash lifts off as the pin pops loose and tips over, then it is struck through the loose pin again; letting go stands the pin back up.

name: icon-pin
title: Pin icon
description: Unpinned ↔ pinned. The tilted pin swings upright, then drives down into the board with a short press; unpinning pops it back out at an angle. `active` = pinned.

name: icon-pipette
title: Pipette icon
description: Picking a color: the bulb is squeezed and a drop forms at the tip of the dropper and falls, and the bulb springs back.

name: icon-plane
title: Plane icon
description: Taking off: the plane surges ahead along its heading, eases back and holds its line.

name: icon-play
title: Play icon
description: Play ↔ pause. The triangle folds into the left bar while the right bar slides out from its tip. `active` = playing.

name: icon-plug
title: Plug icon
description: Plugged ↔ unplugged. The halves pull apart along their axis and the prongs slide out of the socket into view; plugging back in pushes them home. `active` = unplugged.

name: icon-plus-minus
title: Plus Minus icon
description: More or less: the plus turns a quarter and the minus under it pulls in and out.

name: icon-plus
title: Plus icon
description: Plus ↔ close. A quarter-and-an-eighth turn; the cross lands as an ×.

name: icon-podcast
title: Podcast icon
description: On air: the waves ripple out from the source, inner ones first.

name: icon-pound-sterling
title: Pound Sterling icon
description: Money in pounds: the stroke is written again from the hook down to the foot.

name: icon-power
title: Power icon
description: Power on: the switch line drops in, then the ring is drawn closed around it from both sides.

name: icon-presentation
title: Presentation icon
description: The trend on the board is drawn again, left to right, as if being presented.

name: icon-printer
title: Printer icon
description: The sheet is drawn back in and fed out again, printed line first, while the status light blinks.

name: icon-puzzle
title: Puzzle icon
description: Fitting it in: the piece lifts out, turns to find the fit, and drops back into place with a small settle.

name: icon-qr-code
title: QR Code icon
description: A code to scan. A scan line sweeps down across it, fading in at the top and out at the bottom.

name: icon-quote
title: Quote icon
description: The marks nod one after the other, like the cadence of someone speaking.

name: icon-radar
title: Radar icon
description: Scanning: the sweep goes once round the scope and the contact it passes flares. Rest is a full turn, so leaving mid-sweep carries on forwards.

name: icon-radio
title: Radio icon
description: Tuning in: the antenna sways and the speaker pulses to the sound.

name: icon-rainbow
title: Rainbow icon
description: The bands are drawn across the sky one after another, outermost first.

name: icon-receipt
title: Receipt icon
description: Printing: the lines are typed onto the slip one after another, then it is torn off with a short tug.

name: icon-record
title: Record icon
description: Record ↔ stop. The red-dot circle squares off into a stop button inside its ring, corner by corner at once; stopping rounds it back into the dot. `active` = recording (shows stop).

name: icon-rectangle-horizontal
title: Rectangle Horizontal icon
description: A press: the shape squashes toward its base like a button pushed in, then springs back to its size.

name: icon-redo
title: Redo icon
description: Step forward. The arrow winds a notch clockwise around its hook, the direction it travels, and eases home.

name: icon-refresh
title: Refresh icon
description: One full turn with a hard ease-out. Rest is 360°, not 0°, so leaving mid-spin finishes the turn forwards instead of unwinding it.

name: icon-regex
title: Regex icon
description: Any character, any number of times: the star turns a sixth and lands on itself while the dot holds still. Rest is 60° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-remove-formatting
title: Remove Formatting icon
description: Clear formatting: each stroke of the × beside the letter pinches in to its centre and snaps back.

name: icon-repeat
title: Repeat icon
description: Repeat ↔ repeat one. The loop turns a half-cycle, landing on its own silhouette, and a 1 is written at its center; turning back erases it first. `active` = repeat one.

name: icon-replace
title: Replace icon
description: The two arrows chase each other half a turn round the pair, which lands them back on their own shapes, while each box dips as it is swapped. Rest is 180° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-reply
title: Reply icon
description: Sent back: the arrow winds up, stretches out to the left and snaps back into shape.

name: icon-responsive
title: Responsive icon
description: Desktop ↔ mobile. The stand folds up into a home bar and the screen draws itself narrow and tall into a phone; going back, the screen widens first and the stand drops out beneath it. `active` = mobile.

name: icon-rewind
title: Rewind icon
description: Mirror of fast-forward: both triangles surge backward twice, the rear one chasing the front a beat behind.

name: icon-rocket
title: Rocket icon
description: Idle ↔ launched. Ignition: the flame catches and flickers, the hull shudders, then it lifts off along its heading and holds there; throttling down settles it back on the pad before the flame dies. `active` = launched.

name: icon-rotate-ccw
title: Rotate Ccw icon
description: Rotate counter-clockwise. The arrow runs one full turn back round its own ring with a hard ease-out. Rest is −360°, so leaving mid-turn finishes the turn instead of unwinding it.

name: icon-rotate-cw
title: Rotate Cw icon
description: Rotate clockwise. The arrow runs one full turn round its own ring with a hard ease-out. Rest is 360°, so leaving mid-turn finishes forwards.

name: icon-route
title: Route icon
description: The trip is planned: the start pulses, the route is traced out of it, and the destination lands with a settle as the line arrives.

name: icon-router
title: Router icon
description: Online: the signal waves ripple up from the antenna and the status lights blink in turn.

name: icon-rows-2
title: Rows 2 icon
description: Comfortable rows. The divider splits into the two of the standard layout and they fold back together, so the rows settle open again.

name: icon-rows
title: Rows icon
description: Comfortable ↔ compact, for table and list density. The rows close up as a new divider peels off the first and settles in the middle; relaxing folds it back and the rows open out. `active` = compact.

name: icon-rss
title: RSS icon
description: A new post goes out: the arcs go dark and light up again from the source outward, like wifi finding its signal.

name: icon-ruler
title: Ruler icon
description: Measuring: a reading runs down the ruler, each mark reaching out in turn as it passes.

name: icon-save
title: Save icon
description: Save → saved. The disk takes the write, its label folds flat and the line's ends lift into a check. `active` = saved.

name: icon-scan-barcode
title: Scan Barcode icon
description: A scan: the laser line switches on at the top of the code, sweeps down across the bars and back, and switches off.

name: icon-scan-face
title: Scan Face icon
description: Scanning ↔ verified. The corner brackets close in and lock on, the eyes blink shut and the smile swings up into a check. `active` = verified.

name: icon-scissors
title: Scissors icon
description: Two quick snips: both blades close on the pivot and open again, twice, the second cut a touch firmer.

name: icon-screen-share
title: Screen Share icon
description: Share screen ↔ stop sharing. The upload arrow on the screen folds into an ×: its head flattens into one diagonal while the shaft tips over into the other; stopping unfolds it back into the arrow. `active` = sharing (shows stop).

name: icon-search-x
title: Search X icon
description: No results. The magnifier shakes its head, wagging from the end of its handle, while each stroke of the × pinches in to its center and snaps back.

name: icon-search
title: Search icon
description: The lens breathes once and a glint sweeps across the glass.

name: icon-send
title: Send icon
description: The plane pulls back, flies out along its heading and glides back in from the opposite corner.

name: icon-server
title: Server icon
description: Under load: each unit's status light flickers out of step with the other while its throughput meter surges.

name: icon-settings
title: Settings icon
description: The gear turns exactly one tooth-pitch (45°) with a heavy ease-out, as if driven by a ratchet. Rest is 45° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-shapes
title: Shapes icon
description: The three shapes pop one after another: circle, then square, then triangle.

name: icon-share
title: Share icon
description: Connections are drawn out from the source node, and each recipient pops as its line arrives.

name: icon-shield-alert
title: Shield Alert icon
description: Alert ↔ resolved. The shield braces, the exclamation bar tips over into the long stroke of a check and its dot stretches into the short one. `active` = resolved.

name: icon-shield-check
title: Shield Check icon
description: The shield braces (a short squash) and the check is re-sealed onto it.

name: icon-shield-off
title: Shield Off icon
description: Protection off ↔ on. The slash retracts and the shield braces back into service; turning it off draws the slash again with a gap cut behind. `active` = on.

name: icon-shield-plus
title: Shield Plus icon
description: Add protection: the shield braces and the plus inside it turns a quarter.

name: icon-shield-x
title: Shield X icon
description: Blocked: the shield shakes off a hit while each stroke of the × pinches in to its centre and snaps back.

name: icon-shield
title: Shield icon
description: Deflect: the shield braces against a hit and a force field ripples out from its center through the outline.

name: icon-ship
title: Ship icon
description: At sea: the ship rolls on the swell and rights itself.

name: icon-shopping-bag
title: Shopping Bag icon
description: Picked up: the handle draws taut first, the bag follows it up a beat later with its weight, then sets back down.

name: icon-shopping-basket
title: Shopping Basket icon
description: Added to the basket: it dips under the weight and the handles swing back.

name: icon-shopping-cart
title: Shopping Cart icon
description: Empty ↔ item added. A parcel drops in through the open top and lands with a settle while the basket dips on its wheels to take the weight. Removing it lifts it back out. `active` = item in the cart.

name: icon-shuffle
title: Shuffle icon
description: Re-deal. Both routes are redrawn from the left at once, crossing mid-way (the broken one picks up again past the crossing), and each head is pushed out as its route arrives.

name: icon-sidebar
title: Sidebar icon
description: Sidebar open ↔ closed. The panel's divider pulls free of the frame and folds into a chevron pointing where the sidebar will come back from; opening unfolds it into the divider again. `active` = closed.

name: icon-sigma
title: Sigma icon
description: The sum is written out: one continuous pen stroke from the top serif, down the diagonals, to the bottom serif.

name: icon-signal
title: Signal icon
description: Full ↔ weak. The bars fall back to the baseline from the strongest down, leaving a dot in each empty slot; when signal returns they climb back up in order. `active` = weak.

name: icon-signature
title: Signature icon
description: Signing: the pen writes the signature again in one stroke, above the line it is signed on.

name: icon-signpost
title: Signpost icon
description: Which way: the two boards swing on the post, one after the other, and settle.

name: icon-siren
title: Siren icon
description: Incident. The glint inside the dome sweeps once round the lamp and each ray flashes as it passes. Rest is a full turn, so leaving mid-sweep carries on forwards instead of unwinding.

name: icon-skip-back
title: Skip Back icon
description: Mirror of skip-forward: the triangle leaps back into the bar, the bar takes the hit, and the triangle re-enters from the right.

name: icon-skip-forward
title: Skip Forward icon
description: The triangle leaps into the bar; the bar takes the hit and the triangle re-enters.

name: icon-sliders
title: Sliders icon
description: Tuning: the three knobs glide to new values, each a beat after the last, and hold there while hovered; release slides them home.

name: icon-smartphone
title: Smartphone icon
description: Ring ↔ vibrate. The phone buzzes against the table and vibration ticks flicker out from its sides. `active` = vibrate.

name: icon-smile-plus
title: Smile Plus icon
description: React ↔ reacted, for emoji reactions. The plus spins away, the face closes its ring where the plus was and the smile widens into a grin; removing the reaction opens the ring and spins the plus back in. `active` = reacted.

name: icon-smile
title: Smile icon
description: A wink: the face tilts, one eye squeezes shut and the smile widens, then it all relaxes.

name: icon-snowflake
title: Snowflake icon
description: Crystallising: the flake turns one sixth, landing on its own silhouette, as frost re-forms on each arm tip in turn. Rest is 60° so leaving mid-turn finishes it forwards.

name: icon-sort
title: Sort icon
description: Ascending ↔ descending. The arrow's head folds flat across the shaft and turns over to point the other way while the top and bottom bars trade lengths, top first. `active` = descending.

name: icon-sparkle
title: Sparkle icon
description: Off ↔ on, for AI features and smart modes. The star twirls a quarter turn as it swells and fills, and a small companion star pops in beside it with a settle; switching off deflates it and lets the companion go. `active` = on.

name: icon-sparkles
title: Sparkles icon
description: Three sparkles twinkle out of phase: the big one breathes, the small ones blink and turn.

name: icon-speaker
title: Speaker icon
description: Playing: the woofer thumps twice and the tweeter flickers with it.

name: icon-spline
title: Spline icon
description: Editing a curve: the anchors nudge toward each other and the curve flexes almost straight, then springs back into its bend.

name: icon-sprout
title: Sprout icon
description: Growing: the stem stretches up out of the ground and each leaf unfurls from where it joins the stem, the lower one first.

name: icon-square-check
title: Square Check icon
description: Unchecked ↔ checked, for tasks and to-dos. The box opens its top corner and a check is written through it, the long arm breaking out of the box; unchecking erases the check and closes the corner behind it. `active` = checked.

name: icon-square-dashed
title: Square Dashed icon
description: A selection box: the dashed square turns a quarter and lands on its own outline. Rest is 90° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-square-minus
title: Square Minus icon
description: The bar pulls in from both ends and springs back out while the box gives under the press.

name: icon-square-pen
title: Square Pen icon
description: Editing: the pen scribbles a few quick strokes against the open corner of the page and settles back.

name: icon-square-plus
title: Square Plus icon
description: Add → added. The plus swings into a check inside the box and lands with a small settle. `active` = added.

name: icon-square-x
title: Square X icon
description: The cross is struck again, one stroke after the other, like marking a box closed.

name: icon-square
title: Square icon
description: A quarter turn: the square dips, turns exactly 90° and lands on its own silhouette. It's 16 units a side, the same area as the r9 circle, so the two read as one size. Rest is 90° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-star-half
title: Star Half icon
description: A half rating: the fill drains out of the left half and pours back in up to the middle.

name: icon-star
title: Star icon
description: A precise one-fifth turn: the star dips, rotates exactly one point and lands on its own silhouette. Rest is 72° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-sticky-note
title: Sticky Note icon
description: The note is peeled up at its corner, flutters, and sticks back down.

name: icon-store
title: Store icon
description: Open ↔ closed. The awning rolls up into its bar and a roller shutter comes down over the shopfront, slat by slat from under the awning. Opening rolls it back up. `active` = closed.

name: icon-strikethrough
title: Strikethrough icon
description: A pen stroke slashes through the letter from left to right, and its two halves jolt apart as it passes, then close.

name: icon-subscript
title: Subscript icon
description: The small figure dips below the line and bobs back up to its place beside the letter.

name: icon-sun
title: Sun icon
description: Clear skies: the rays turn one step round the sun while the core draws in a breath and glows back out.

name: icon-sunrise
title: Sunrise icon
description: Sunrise ↔ sunset. The sun sinks behind the horizon, rays and all, as the arrow above turns to point down; sunrise lifts it back up and turns the arrow over. `active` = sunset.

name: icon-superscript
title: Superscript icon
description: The small figure lifts above the line and settles back to its place beside the letter.

name: icon-table
title: Table icon
description: A row is inserted: a new row line slides out from under the header rule and drops into place.

name: icon-tablet
title: Tablet icon
description: Portrait ↔ landscape. The tablet turns a quarter-turn and dips in scale mid-turn so its corners never leave the grid. `active` = landscape.

name: icon-tag
title: Tag icon
description: The tag swings on its hole like a price tag hanging from a string, damping out to rest.

name: icon-tags
title: Tags icon
