description: The front tag swings on its hole and the one behind follows a beat later, both damping out to rest.

name: icon-target
title: Target icon
description: Open ↔ hit, for goals and targets reached. An arrow flies in along the diagonal and sticks in the bullseye with a settle, knocking the target back a touch; reopening pulls it out the way it came. `active` = hit.

name: icon-terminal
title: Terminal icon
description: The prompt steps forward and the cursor blinks twice, waiting for input.

name: icon-text-cursor-input
title: Text Cursor Input icon
description: The word is deleted back to the caret, typed again in three keystrokes with the caret stepping along behind it, and the caret blinks twice.

name: icon-text-search
title: Text Search icon
description: The lens sweeps back along the lines it is reading and returns to its place.

name: icon-text-sparkle
title: Text Sparkle icon
description: Rewrite with AI. Each line of text is taken back and written again, top to bottom, and the star at the end of the paragraph turns a quarter as the last line lands.

name: icon-theme
title: Theme icon
description: Sun ↔ moon. The rays retract into the core one after another, then the core swells and a bite sweeps in to carve the crescent. `active` = dark.

name: icon-thermometer
title: Thermometer icon
description: Low ↔ high. The bulb flushes and the mercury climbs the tube, nudging each degree mark as it passes; cooling drains it back down. `active` = high.

name: icon-thumbs-down
title: Thumbs Down icon
description: Dislike → disliked, the pair to thumbs-up for rating answers. The hand tips up on its wrist, flicks down past level and settles while the palm fills; the cuff stays open. `active` = disliked.

name: icon-thumbs-up
title: Thumbs Up icon
description: Like → liked. The hand tips back on its wrist, flicks forward past upright and settles (an earned bounce) while the palm fills. The cuff stays open. `active` = liked.

name: icon-ticket
title: Ticket icon
description: Valid ↔ used, for tickets, passes and coupons. The stub tears away along the perforation and drops loose as the perforation marks go with it; restoring it presses the stub back into place. `active` = used.

name: icon-timer
title: Timer icon
description: The crown is pressed and the hand runs one full lap, landing back on its mark. The hand rests at a full turn, so leaving mid-lap finishes forwards.

name: icon-toggle
title: Toggle icon
description: Off ↔ on. The knob stretches across the track like a drop of mercury, its far end arriving first, then gathers itself at the other stop and fills; switching off drains it and throws it back the same way. `active` = on.

name: icon-tornado
title: Tornado icon
description: The funnel twists: each band sways the other way from the one above it.

name: icon-train
title: Train icon
description: Arriving: the train rocks on the rails and its headlights flash.

name: icon-trash
title: Trash icon
description: The lid lifts off its left hinge and hangs open while hovered.

name: icon-trending-down
title: Trending Down icon
description: Falling ↔ rising. The trend flips through its flat midpoint to its mirror image and the arrowhead turns with the line's end. `active` = rising.

name: icon-trending-up
title: Trending Up icon
description: The trend is drawn upward and the arrowhead is pushed out ahead of it.

name: icon-triangle
title: Triangle icon
description: A third of a turn: the triangle tightens, rotates one corner on and lands on its own outline. Rest is 120° so leaving mid-turn completes forwards.

name: icon-trophy
title: Trophy icon
description: Unearned ↔ earned. The cup fills from the bottom up, then the trophy hops and lands on its base with a settle; giving it back drains the cup. `active` = earned.

name: icon-truck
title: Truck icon
description: Dispatch: the truck rocks back, surges forward nose-up as speed lines streak off its tail, then rolls back onto its mark.

name: icon-tv
title: Tv icon
description: Finding a channel: the antenna is nudged one way and the other until the picture settles.

name: icon-type
title: Type icon
description: Typesetting: the crossbar is ruled out from the stem to both serifs, then the foot is set beneath it.

name: icon-umbrella
title: Umbrella icon
description: Shaking off the rain: the canopy furls tight around the shaft, then snaps back open and flicks a drop off each rib end.

name: icon-underline
title: Underline icon
description: The rule is struck beneath the letter from left to right while the letter lifts to make room, then settles onto it.

name: icon-undo
title: Undo icon
description: Undo ↔ redo. The arrow turns over like a card on its vertical axis, so the head and the hook trade sides; holding Shift in an editor is the natural trigger. Toggling mid-turn turns it back. `active` = redo.

name: icon-unlink
title: Unlink icon
description: Linked ↔ unlinked, for links and locked aspect ratios. The bar snaps and the halves spring apart, throwing sparks from the break; relinking pulls them back together and the bar rejoins them. `active` = unlinked.

name: icon-upload
title: Upload icon
description: The tray pushes, the arrow launches out of the top and a new one rises from the tray.

name: icon-usb
title: Usb icon
description: Plugging in: the connector pushes up into the port and eases back.

name: icon-user-check
title: User Check icon
description: Verified: the check is signed off beside the person, lands with a small settle, and the person nods.

name: icon-user-cog
title: User Cog icon
description: Account settings: the cog beside the person turns one tooth on and the person nods.

name: icon-user-minus
title: User Minus icon
description: Removing someone: the minus is struck toward the person, who steps back and fades before returning.

name: icon-user-pen
title: User Pen icon
description: Edit profile: the pen beside the person scribbles and the person nods.

name: icon-user-plus
title: User Plus icon
description: Invite → invited. The plus swings into a check and the person gives a welcoming nod. `active` = invited.

name: icon-user-search
title: User Search icon
description: Finding someone: the lens beside the person looks up and down and the person nods.

name: icon-user-shield
title: User Shield icon
description: Protected account: the shield beside the person braces and springs back, and the person nods.

name: icon-user-x
title: User X icon
description: Remove someone. The × turns a quarter beside the person, tucking in as it goes, while the person leans back from it and rights again.

name: icon-user
title: User icon
description: A small nod: the head dips and comes back up, and the shoulders follow through a beat later.

name: icon-users
title: Users icon
description: The group acknowledges you: a nod runs from the front person to the one behind.

name: icon-variable
title: Variable icon
description: The brackets close in on the x as it turns a quarter, then let go.

name: icon-vault
title: Vault icon
description: Cracking the combination: the wheel turns one way, back the other, and settles.

name: icon-verified
title: Verified icon
description: Unverified ↔ verified, for accounts and publishers. The plain badge crimps into a rosette with a stamp's twist and the check is inked inside it; revoking erases the check and smooths the rosette back into a circle. `active` = verified.

name: icon-video
title: Video icon
description: Camera on ↔ off. The lens blinks shut as the feed cuts and a slash is drawn through, with a matching gap masked behind it. Turning it back on pulls the slash out and the lens blinks open. `active` = off.

name: icon-voicemail
title: Voicemail icon
description: The message plays: the two reels draw in on the tape and let it out again.

name: icon-volume
title: Volume icon
description: Volume ↔ muted. The sound waves retract outermost-first, then the × is crossed out stroke by stroke. Unmuting plays it back in reverse order.

name: icon-wallet
title: Wallet icon
description: Paying from the wallet: the clasp tab slips open and a card slides up out of the top at a tilt, held while hovered.

name: icon-wand
title: Wand icon
description: A flick of the wand: it swings from the wrist, the star at its tip spins a quarter turn, and two glints wink on in its wake. Rest is the quarter turn, so leaving mid-spin finishes forwards.

name: icon-watch
title: Watch icon
description: Setting the time: the crown pulls out, the minute hand sweeps a full hour, and the crown clicks back in. Rest is 360° so leaving mid-sweep finishes the turn forwards.

name: icon-waves
title: Waves icon
description: Waves ↔ calm, for sea state, noise and vibration. The waves smooth out line by line from the top until the water is flat; stirring it raises them again from the bottom. `active` = calm.

name: icon-webcam
title: Webcam icon
description: The lens looks around the room, left then right, and comes back to you.

name: icon-webhook
title: Webhook icon
description: An event is delivered: the payload is handed from hook to hook around the loop, each one re-traced as it arrives.

name: icon-wifi-off
title: Wifi Off icon
description: Offline ↔ online. The slash is pulled out and the gap closes, then the signal comes back from the source outward, one arc at a time; dropping the connection strikes the slash back through. `active` = online.

name: icon-wifi
title: Wifi icon
description: Searching for signal: the arcs go dark, then light up from the source outward.

name: icon-wind
title: Wind icon
description: A gust: each stream is blown through, its tail running off into the curl, and a fresh stream blows in from the left behind it, one after another.

name: icon-workflow
title: Workflow icon
description: A run: the first step presses, the connector carries the signal down and across, and the next step lights up as it arrives.

name: icon-wrap-text
title: Wrap Text icon
description: No wrap ↔ wrap, for editors and code views. The overflowing line curls down at the margin and runs back along the next line, and an arrowhead lands at its end; unwrapping erases the head and straightens the line out to the edge. `active` = wrap.

name: icon-wrench
title: Wrench icon
description: A ratchet turn: the wrench swings on the nut in its jaw, a quick pull and a precise return, dipping in scale so the handle never leaves the grid.

name: icon-x
title: X icon
description: Close. The cross turns a quarter on its center, tucking in as it goes, and lands on its own silhouette.

name: icon-yen
title: Yen icon
description: Money in yen: the arms are written again down to the stem.

name: icon-zap
title: Zap icon
description: A charge runs the length of the bolt as it is redrawn from the top, and the bolt kicks down with the strike.

name: icon-zoom-in
title: Zoom In icon
description: Zoom in ↔ zoom out. The lens pulls back a touch as the plus folds its upright into the crossbar; zooming in again pushes the lens forward and the upright springs back out of the center. `active` = zoom out.

name: icon-zoom-out
title: Zoom Out icon
description: Zoom out. The lens pulls back a step while the minus narrows and widens again.

name: icons
title: Youj icon set
description: All 511 animated icons, YoujIcon and the engine, with an index that exports them plus an `icons` array.
